news.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 net profit rises 41% on strong income growth, plans Rs 5000 crore capital raise
news.summary: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance reported a 41% rise in second-quarter net profit to Rs 1,630 crore, helped by strong income growth, higher loan disbursements and lower loan losses. The company’s board approved a proposal to raise up to Rs 5,000 crore through a qualified institutional placement.

news.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2 profit jumps 41% as scooter and EV sales surge
news.summary: Hero MotoCorp’s Q2 FY27 consolidated profit rose 41% to Rs 1,860.55 crore, while revenue increased 23% to Rs 14,970.50 crore. Scooter sales surged 47%, VIDA retail sales grew 76%, and international expansion strengthened growth prospects.

news.summary: Indian markets closed lower on Wednesday as rising crude oil prices and Middle East tensions hurt sentiment. Sensex fell 353 points to 73,246, while Nifty slipped 51 points to 22,699 despite a late recovery.

news.title: Acutaas Chemicals among 5 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 18% in a month
news.summary: Despite the Sensex falling 352 points to 73,246, five BSE 500 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs on Wednesday. PVR Inox, Acutaas Chemicals, Indian Hotels, Piramal Pharma and Sona BLW posted monthly gains of 9% to 18%.

news.title: Vedanta Aluminium Q2 Results: Profit doubles to Rs 6,187 crore, revenue jumps 41%
news.summary: Vedanta Aluminium’s Q2 FY27 net profit surged 105% to Rs 6,187 crore, driven by record production, higher sales and improved realisations. Revenue rose 41%, EBITDA increased 83%, and net debt declined Rs 3,090 crore sequentially.

news.title: Sebi signs MoU with Bank of England to strengthen oversight of clearing corporations
news.summary: SEBI and the Bank of England signed an MoU to strengthen regulatory cooperation and information sharing on clearing corporations. The framework supports cross-border supervision, enables reliance on SEBI’s oversight, and reinforces financial stability.

news.title: Ola Electric stock jumps 11% in week; rights issue fully subscribed ahead of closing date - Check key details
news.summary: Ola Electric shares rose 4.95% to ₹36.68 on Wednesday, extending a two-session winning streak and gaining about 11% in a week. The company’s ₹1,000-crore rights issue was fully subscribed, with 37.13 crore shares subscribed against 37.02 crore offered.

news.title: Crompton Greaves shares rebound 4% after recent losses: Can the beaten-down stock sustain its recovery?
news.summary: Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals shares rose 4% to ₹204. Choice Equity Broking sees scope for a recovery toward ₹230, citing support at ₹190– ₹200 and improving technical indicators. Other brokerages maintain Buy ratings with targets of ₹275– ₹300.

news.title: 67% rally in 6 months, 14% crash in a week: What changed for this jewellery stock under ₹50? Do you own it?
news.summary: PC Jeweller shares fell for a fifth consecutive session, losing nearly 14% in a week after reaching a 52-week high. The pullback follows a 67% six-month rally and appears driven by profit-taking, despite the company reporting a 58% annual rise in second-quarter net profit.
